description: Municipal Treated Wastewater Effluent is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. The flows and effluent quality data is for the parameters of: Biological Oxygen Demand BOD5/CBOD5 Total Suspended Solids (TSS), also described as Residual Particulate Solids Total Phosphorus (TP) total monthly flow Keywords: Sewage, Effluent, Discharge, Watershed, Waterworks, Water management, Muncipality. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. Its tags are Eaux usées, Grand Lacs, Great Lakes, Lac, Lake. It offers 19 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
